files.verification: Real corrected browser menu, keyboard-keyboard mode, ship movement and ordinary Space shots remove aliens and display score30. Actual ARM64 fortified object compilation includes the owning renderer declaration.

files.reason: Include owning renderer/keyboard declarations and pass XPM line arrays with their actual pointer type.
files.verification: Actual original print_menu strict compile fails undeclared void renderer and keyboard calls; fixed menu renders four original XPMs once, presents once and handles ordinary Escape. Original LLVM IR called title_creator as i32 while its definition returns void; browser trapped before menu.

files.reason: Declare the message pixmap as an array of XPM lines, matching its actual consumer.
files.verification: Real fixed game compilation checks the XPM array across game.c and print.c, without incompatible pointer casts.

files.reason: Include the owning device/menu declarations, preserving their actual void and integer contracts.
files.verification: Actual original entry strict compile fails undeclared calls; corrected entry executes one startup, subscription, menu and teardown with original PLAYER argument.

files.reason: Store XPM line-array pointers as char**, preserving the original pointer-sized structure layout.
files.verification: Real fixed game compilation checks the XPM array across game.c and xpm.c, without incompatible pointer casts.

files.reason: Free each temporary decoded pixmap after copying its pixels; repeated frame drawing previously leaked every allocation.
files.verification: Actual object_creator/title_creator replay100 draws copies independently expected pixels but original leaves outstanding allocations; corrected source frees the original allocation address after each copy.

controlsRationale: W/S navigate original menus, Enter selects. Default proof selects Keyboard/Keyboard (one S after opening New Game). A/D move ship and Space release fires. Enter leaves the arena. Reserved panel keeps original score/time HUD visible. Original physical mouse modes remain available but their full packet handling is not claimed verified.

artwork.icon: Original spaceship art from actual source-rendered arena, isolated against a simple navy square, enlarged nearest-neighbor. Original XPM bytes unchanged.
artwork.preview: Actual current-source browser game screenshot with score30, resized within640pixels.

verification.browser: Original New Game then keyboard mode, ship moves right, Space shots remove enemies and score30 appears. Portrait/landscape touch layout reviewed.
verification.ndk: All13 actual selected/generated ARM64 objects compile atO2/FORTIFY2/stack-protector/format-security.
verification.limitations: No full victory claim; physical mouse modes not qualified.

nativeGameplay.demonstrated: ROOT viewed actual Android New Game/keyboard-mode selection, five original alien rows and Time Left HUD, visible ship movement, ordinary released Space removing a bottom-row alien with actual score6, and clean Library Home ending the isolated native game process. ROOT also reviewed all3 current browser gallery states including score90.
limitations: A full wave/victory, mouse-control variants, physical-phone performance and native authored Quit are not demonstrated. Native positive score is6, distinct from the separately observed browser score90. No guest timing, RNG, rules or artwork was changed.
